Sparky charges up over time, releasing her attack when it is full and an enemy is within range; the charge is kept across targets and only a stun resets it. https://clashroyale.fandom.com/wiki/Sparky

Deployment is a horizontal line spanning the Arena (the game data's summonRadius 500 is not that); shifting the central tile by one turns the 3-3 lane split into 4-2, which bounds the spacing between 1 and 3 tiles; 2 puts the outer recruits in front of the Princess Towers. https://clashroyale.fandom.com/wiki/Royal_Recruits

The Bowler cannot reset the charges of the Prince and Dark Prince because they are immune to knockback; the Prince has an immunity to all forms of knockback, unlike the Battle Ram. https://clashroyale.fandom.com/wiki/Bowler https://clashroyale.fandom.com/wiki/Prince
